issues.title: Faisal ready to calm storm at Gelora as Malaysia battle Indonesia in Asean Cup
issues.title_en: Faisal ready to calm storm at Gelora as Malaysia battle Indonesia in Asean Cup
issues.summary: PETALING JAYA: National football team winger Faisal Halim says he is unfazed by the hostile atmosphere at the Gelora Bung Karno Stadium and has urged his teammates to be ready both mentally and physically when Malaysia take on Indonesia in their FIFA Asean Cup Group A match on Monday (Sept 28).
issues.volunteer_impact: 기상 및 재난 상황에 따라 현장 활동과 이동 일정이 변경될 수 있습니다.
